## VITROS^{™} Systems

VITROS^{™} systems enable fast, accurate and reliable results to help labs of every size achieve
operational and cost-efficiency objectives – today and into the future.

[ Learn more ][138]
[VITROS™ Systems]

## SOFIA^{™} Platform

Our SOFIA^{™} 2 Analyzer, the next generation in benchtop diagnostic testing, takes rapid testing to
the next level. Learn about our testing solutions with SOFIA.

[ Learn more ][139]
[SOFIA™ Platform]

## ORTHO^{™} Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer

QuidelOrtho's ORTHO^{™} Workstation is a scalable semi-automated immunohematology solution built
around proven column agglutination technology.

[ Learn more ][140]
[ORTHO™ Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer]

## ORTHO OPTIX^{™} Reader

When linked to the ORTHO^{™} Workstation, the ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader is a complete semi-automated
immunohematology testing solution for transfusion labs.

Our deep insight into our partners’ offerings, combined with a keen sensitivity to the unique needs

## Your Partner
## In Clinical
## Diagnosis

Founded in 1983, All Eights has established long term partnerships with our local clinical
laboratory community and notable manufacturers.

### All Eights Group

##### Reliable Distributor for Medical, Analytical and Laboratory Products

All Eights Group is a company specialising in the distribution of products for Clinical Diagnostic,
Analytical Science and Scientific Equipment
 
Companies looking to expand their business outside their domestic market face many challenges. Our
role is to be their best possible partner, based on our expertise in our market as well as the
network and reach of our existing customer base.
 
With a strong track record, we have established ourselves as a reliable partner.
 
Today, we are present in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.

### Our Focus Areas:

###### Clinical Diagnostics

All Eights serves the clinical diagnostic customers in the field of Hemostasis, Biochemistry,
Immunoassays, Microbiology, Infectious Diseases, Molecular Oncology, Blood Banking, etc…

###### Analytical Science

Our Analytical Science customers span across Biomolecular Processing, Food Safety, Agriculture
Analysis, Industrial Microbiology, Life Science Research, etc…

## Our Sectors

##### Clinical Diagnostic, Analytical Science & Scientific Equipment Distribution

Our network expands across Clinical and Analytical Science. As both markets reach out to different
customers with different needs, we serve our clinical customers through our core company, All
Eights, and the Analytical Science’s customers through our subsidiary, Beacon Sciences.

### All Eights Group

##### Reliable Distributor for Medical, Analytical and Laboratory Products

All Eights Group is a company specialising in the distribution of products for Clinical Diagnostic,
Analytical Science and Scientific Equipment
 
Companies looking to expand their business outside their domestic market face many challenges. Our
role is to be their best possible partner, based on our expertise in our market as well as the
network and reach of our existing customer base.

Analysis, Industrial Microbiology, Life Science Research, etc…

## Making Point-of-care testing affordable around the world

Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

These products are used in hospitals, clinical laboratories, physician offices, blood banks,
pharmacies and veterinary clinics.

[ACON's Story][27]

### Our Brands

#### Blood Glucose Meter Systems

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]
[Mission POCT]

#### Point-of-care testing (POCT)

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]
[HealthyMe Logo]

#### Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)

ACON Labs has been the leading UTI manufacturer in the US. The HealthyMe Urinary Tract Infection
reagent strips are highly reliable and easy to use.

[View Product][30]
[ACON Laboratories, Inc]

#### Lateral Flow Rapid Tests

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

[View Product Line][31]
[Mission POCT]

#### Our Newest Brand

Flowflex^{TM} is the newest brand addition to the ACON product portfolio.  The Flowflex SARS-CoV-2
Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

#### Pregnancy Rapid Tests

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]
[Mission POCT]

#### Allergen Test Kit

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

#### Molecular Diagnostics

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]
[[ACON San Diego]][37]

  Company
  
  ADNOC Gas is a world-class integrated gas company operating an unmatched asset base that supplies
  around 60% of the UAE’s natural gas requirements and serves customers in more than 20 countries.

  Our Operations
  
  Our extensive onshore and offshore operations produce a full range of valuable gas products. We
  maintain a constant focus on operational excellence, asset reliability and HSE performance.
  
  Our Operations>Gas Processing
  
  Operating at the heart of the UAE’s hydrocarbon value chain, we receive feed gas from ADNOC’s
  onshore and offshore production operations, and produce a mixture of sales gas, NGLs, condensate
  and sulfur to serve our downstream customers.
  
  Our Operations>LNG Operations
  
  Our liquefaction facilities supply LNG from gas produced in ADNOC’s offshore operations for export
  to utilities and industrial customers around the globe.
  
  Our Operations>Pipeline Network
  
  Our extensive 3,260km gas pipeline network enables delivery of sales gas to customers across Abu
  Dhabi, Dubai and the Northern Emirates, meeting ~60 % of UAE’s gas requirements
  
  Our Operations>Industrial Gases
  
  We are one of the UAE’s major suppliers of industrial gases, primarily nitrogen and oxygen.
  
  Our Operations>Other Products
  
  We produce several other associated products, primarily for use in the chemicals sector by
  customers both in the UAE and overseas.

  Sustainability
  
  We apply a determined focus on sustainability across our business.
  
  Sustainability>Environment
  
  We have developed a robust road map of projects to accelerate significant advances in our
  environmental performance that delivered a 10% reduction in our GHG emissions (2021 vs 2018
  baseline).
  
  Sustainability>Health & Safety
  
  We maintain an unwavering focus on health and safety and are continually striving to drive our
  first quartile performance towards our ultimate goal of ensuring ‘100% HSE’ - keeping our
  employees, communities, the environment and assets safe from harm.
  
  Sustainability>UAE Growth
  
  We act as a powerful catalyst to driving the UAE’s economic development and diversification,
  providing energy and other gas products vital to UAE industry, and ensuring a strong in-country
  value contribution from our operations.
  
  Sustainability>Social Responsibility
  
  In alignment with ADNOC Group, we manage our operations to make a positive contribution to the
  development of our society and the communities in which we operate.
* [Projects][22]

  * [IGD-E2][25]
  Projects
  
  We continue to invest in and develop our gas and LNG processing, transmission and export
  infrastructure, expanding capacity and connectivity, and driving efficiency and sustainability.
  
  Projects>Ruwais LNG
  
  The first LNG export facility in the MENA region to run on clean power. Producing 9.6 million tons
  of LNG per year providing access to reliable and affordable energy.
  
  Projects>IGD-E2
  
  ADNOC Gas continues to invest to increase gas processing capacity and further integrate its
  onshore and offshore facilities. A key component of this program has been the Integrated Gas
  Development project and its subsequent extension phases.

  ENERGYai
  
  Innovation and technology are core to our operations. We are transforming our business, deploying
  cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and digital solutions to manage our
  operations more efficiently, safely and sustainably.
  
  ENERGYai>3D printing
  
  ADNOC Gas is utilizing additive manufacturing (3D-printing) at a number of sites to simplify
  logistics, reduce inventories of physical parts and optimize costs
  
  ENERGYai>CPAD
  
  CPAD provides us with a powerful predictive maintenance platform to optimize operations and
  underpin asset integrity.
  
  ENERGYai>iRTO
  
  Integrated Real Time Optimizer (iRTO) is a multi-site technology optimizing natural gas liquid
  production yields in real time.

Bioantibody Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (Bioantibody) is a high-tech biotechnology company focused on
the R&D and production of antigens, antibodies and downstream detection reagents for diagnosis and
therapy. The product pipelines cover cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, inflammation, infectious
diseases, tumors, hormones and other categories, from raw materials to finished products. Innovation

delivered to more than 60 countries and cities worldwide. Using the ISO 13485 management system, the
product quality is greatly trusted by customers. With the mission [Biotech For A Better Life", we
are committed to innovation and providing our best solutions to our customers. We sincerely believe
we could make our special contribution to human ecology and health. As an IVD solutions provider, we

protecting the human health and hope all of society to have access to clean, affordable, and
reliable biotechnologies. Furthermore, our economic development will be compatible with proper
conduct in relation to ethics, society, the workplace, the environment and respect for human rights.

materialize this commitment, we have developed the sustainability policy on environmental and social
matters.

## ESCHWEILER – automatic analysing systems

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories ESCHWEILER offers a product line of reliable, fully
automatic analysers for the determination of blood gases, electrolytes and t-hemoglobin.

The Company was founded in 1951 by Wilhelm Eschweiler. In the same year the worldwide first
commercially manufactured apparatus – made by ESCHWEILER – for measuring oxygen pressure was
introduced to the market: The very first beginning of blood gas analysis at all ([historic
facts][56]).

In close cooperation with scientific and clinical research departments the ESCHWEILER company is
continuously engaged in decisive developments in the field of blood gas- and electrolyte analysis.
Improvement of measuring methods and automatisation always are the priorities in order to offer
reliable and easy to operate analysers for clinics, medical practices and laboratories.

For more than 60 years ESCHWEILER analysers are in use worldwide. Quality products – made in
Germany.

## Why Choose Us?

At Ganesh diagnostic, we offer multiple services to our patients at affordable prices because your
health is our first priority. We have a skillful and talented team associated with us to deliver the
best to our clients.

A free 24/7 ambulance service is also available to avoid havoc in emergency situations. We have
updated technologies to generate **100% accurate reports** for every test and check-up. We are an
organization that has been trusted by 30,000+ doctors. Active in the business for quite some time.

Back in 2001, famed radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma laid the foundations of this organization after his
father, Ganesh Chand Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a
significant ride of many things. Today, we are considered one of the **best diagnostic centres and
[pathology][116] labs across Delhi**, robust problem solvers, and highly efficient in all areas.

Igloo Reader Pro analyzes rapid diagnostic tests using digital quantitative technology. The device
eliminates subjective visual interpretation and delivers consistent, standardized results within
minutes.
* No laboratory setup required.
* No complex preparation.
* Minimal staff training needed.
* Designed for seamless integration into pharmacies, clinics, and point-of-care environments.

# Providing best in class diagnostic solutions for a healthy nation

# Providing best in class diagnostic solutions for a healthy nation

## Our Expertise

Katalyst Diagnostics is led by a team of best in class medical, logistical, training and customer
service professionals.

Our long-term experience of being at the heart of B2B and B2C service provision ensures we have the
proven skills and workflows in place to ensure service excellence.

Katalyst Diagnostics supports NHS and healthcare organisations across the UK & Ireland with
point-of-care diagnostic solutions used within emergency, oncology, emergency, ambulatory,
paediatric and mental health care pathways


[Our Services][14]

**Katalyst Diagnostics is the market leader in the provision of premium and cutting edge POCT
diagnostic solutions.**

Through constant global market analysis and research, our mission is to make cutting edge
advancements in diagnostic testing accessible within the UK.

Within an ever changing health landscape, we provide cost and time efficient solutions to the NHS
and healthcare professionals to eliminate health inequalities.

[Contact Us][15]

## Our Products

At Katalyst, we focus on 3 core areas which we feel will help have the biggest positive impact on
the health of the nation.

### Haematology

**HemoScreen**™: The **world’s First** and **Only** True Point-of-Care FBC analyser that offers
laboratory quality results within **5 minutes**.

### Antipsychotic Drug Monitoring

**MyCare INSITE™: **The only point-of-care analyser that accurately measures the most commonly
prescribed antipsychotic drugs in** <7 minutes**.

### Clinical Chemistry

**Piccolo Xpress**®: The world’s original innovator in Clinical Chemistry point of care. Piccolo
Xpress Blood Chemistry Analyser that offers laboratory quality results within **12 minutes**.

# Laboratory Equipment Manufacturer for Research & Testing

][27]

Labtron Equipment is a leading manufacturer of innovative Laboratory Equipment and Analytical
Equipment for all kinds of laboratory applications. Our laboratory equipment are compact,
energy-efficient, and durable, featuring built-in safety for versatile use. We offer a range of
laboratory equipment and analytical instruments including centrifuges, chillers, incubators, mixers,
freeze dryers, shakers, petroleum testing, water testing, airborne particle counters, biochemistry

# Complete Diagnostic Supplies for Modern Laboratory Needs

Murex Diagnostics is a trusted medical equipment distributor providing high-quality diagnostic
solutions to laboratories across the Philippines. The company offers a wide range of products, from
analyzers to testing kits, supported by responsive service, technical expertise, and dependable
after-sales support to help laboratories operate efficiently and deliver accurate results.

[Get in Touch][23]
[Afias 6 front]

## Diagnostic Equipment Provider for High-Performing Laboratories

As a leading laboratory equipment supplier in the Philippines, Murex Diagnostics delivers a wide
range of diagnostic solutions designed for accuracy, efficiency, and speed. These specialized
solutions include clinical chemistry, electrolyte analysis, and HbA1c testing, helping laboratories
expand their testing capabilities and reduce the need for external referrals.

The right equipment enables clinics to deliver faster results, improve patient experience, and
support better clinical decisions. Murex Diagnostics helps laboratories scale their operations while
maintaining a commitment to accessible, community-focused diagnostics.

[the Murex team]
[AMS SAT 450][AMS SAT 450]

### Clinical Chemistry

Clinical chemistry systems support the measurement of key biochemical markers, such as glucose,
enzymes, and lipids. Murex Diagnostics supplies clinical chemistry equipment that delivers accurate
results for both routine and specialized diagnostics.

[EC 90 with cartridge][EC 90 with cartridge]

### Electrolyte Analysers

Electrolyte analyzers provide fast and precise measurement of sodium, potassium, and chloride
levels. Murex Diagnostics offers a range of compact and automated systems, giving laboratories the
flexibility to choose solutions that match their workload, space, and testing requirements.

[Greencare A1c][Greencare A1c]

### HbA1c Analyzers

HbA1c analyzers are designed for reliable diabetes monitoring through accurate long-term glucose
assessment. As a medical and lab supplier for clinics of all sizes, Murex Diagnostics offers a range
of compact and automated systems that prioritize accuracy and convenience, helping laboratories
improve turnaround times and deliver dependable results for patient management.

Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

pharmacies and veterinary clinics.

[ACON's Story][27]

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]

#### Point-of-care testing (POCT)

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]
[HealthyMe Logo]

ACON Labs has been the leading UTI manufacturer in the US. The HealthyMe Urinary Tract Infection

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

[View Product Line][31]

Flowflex^{TM} is the newest brand addition to the ACON product portfolio.  The Flowflex SARS-CoV-2
Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

#### Pregnancy Rapid Tests

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]
[Mission POCT]

#### Allergen Test Kit

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]

world's largest integrated energy companies.

gas per day (bscfd), we serve a wide range of domestic and international customers with an expanding
portfolio of products. We supply around 60% of the UAE’s gas needs and export natural gas and
related products to a diverse customer base in over 20 countries.

stability across all diagnostic products.

## ESCHWEILER – automatic analysing systems

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories ESCHWEILER offers a product line of reliable, fully
automatic analysers for the determination of blood gases, electrolytes and t-hemoglobin.

The Company was founded in 1951 by Wilhelm Eschweiler. In the same year the worldwide first
commercially manufactured apparatus – made by ESCHWEILER – for measuring oxygen pressure was
introduced to the market: The very first beginning of blood gas analysis at all ([historic
facts][56]).

In close cooperation with scientific and clinical research departments the ESCHWEILER company is
continuously engaged in decisive developments in the field of blood gas- and electrolyte analysis.
Improvement of measuring methods and automatisation always are the priorities in order to offer
reliable and easy to operate analysers for clinics, medical practices and laboratories.

For more than 60 years ESCHWEILER analysers are in use worldwide. Quality products – made in
Germany.

# Providing best in class diagnostic solutions for a healthy nation

# Providing best in class diagnostic solutions for a healthy nation

## Our Expertise

Katalyst Diagnostics is led by a team of best in class medical, logistical, training and customer
service professionals.

Our long-term experience of being at the heart of B2B and B2C service provision ensures we have the
proven skills and workflows in place to ensure service excellence.

Katalyst Diagnostics supports NHS and healthcare organisations across the UK & Ireland with
point-of-care diagnostic solutions used within emergency, oncology, emergency, ambulatory,
paediatric and mental health care pathways


[Our Services][14]

**Katalyst Diagnostics is the market leader in the provision of premium and cutting edge POCT
diagnostic solutions.**

Through constant global market analysis and research, our mission is to make cutting edge
advancements in diagnostic testing accessible within the UK.

Within an ever changing health landscape, we provide cost and time efficient solutions to the NHS
and healthcare professionals to eliminate health inequalities.

[Contact Us][15]

## Our Products

At Katalyst, we focus on 3 core areas which we feel will help have the biggest positive impact on
the health of the nation.

### Haematology

**HemoScreen**™: The **world’s First** and **Only** True Point-of-Care FBC analyser that offers
laboratory quality results within **5 minutes**.

### Antipsychotic Drug Monitoring

**MyCare INSITE™: **The only point-of-care analyser that accurately measures the most commonly
prescribed antipsychotic drugs in** <7 minutes**.

### Clinical Chemistry

**Piccolo Xpress**®: The world’s original innovator in Clinical Chemistry point of care. Piccolo

# Medica Corporation

Medica Corporation manufactures simple-to-use, highly reliable diagnostic blood testing analyzers.
Actively engaged in developing new technology, Medica specifically designs products to enhance
productivity and the quality of care in small to medium-size *in vitro* diagnostic
laboratories. Medica’s clinical chemistry, blood gas, and electrolyte are focused on the global need
to lower health care costs.

# Complete Diagnostic Supplies for Modern Laboratory Needs

Murex Diagnostics is a trusted medical equipment distributor providing high-quality diagnostic
solutions to laboratories across the Philippines. The company offers a wide range of products, from
analyzers to testing kits, supported by responsive service, technical expertise, and dependable
after-sales support to help laboratories operate efficiently and deliver accurate results.

[Get in Touch][23]
[Afias 6 front]

## Diagnostic Equipment Provider for High-Performing Laboratories

As a leading laboratory equipment supplier in the Philippines, Murex Diagnostics delivers a wide
range of diagnostic solutions designed for accuracy, efficiency, and speed. These specialized
solutions include clinical chemistry, electrolyte analysis, and HbA1c testing, helping laboratories
expand their testing capabilities and reduce the need for external referrals.

The right equipment enables clinics to deliver faster results, improve patient experience, and
support better clinical decisions. Murex Diagnostics helps laboratories scale their operations while
maintaining a commitment to accessible, community-focused diagnostics.

[the Murex team]
[AMS SAT 450][AMS SAT 450]

### Clinical Chemistry

Clinical chemistry systems support the measurement of key biochemical markers, such as glucose,
enzymes, and lipids. Murex Diagnostics supplies clinical chemistry equipment that delivers accurate
results for both routine and specialized diagnostics.

[EC 90 with cartridge][EC 90 with cartridge]

### Electrolyte Analysers

Electrolyte analyzers provide fast and precise measurement of sodium, potassium, and chloride
levels. Murex Diagnostics offers a range of compact and automated systems, giving laboratories the
flexibility to choose solutions that match their workload, space, and testing requirements.

[Greencare A1c][Greencare A1c]

### HbA1c Analyzers

HbA1c analyzers are designed for reliable diabetes monitoring through accurate long-term glucose
assessment. As a medical and lab supplier for clinics of all sizes, Murex Diagnostics offers a range
of compact and automated systems that prioritize accuracy and convenience, helping laboratories
improve turnaround times and deliver dependable results for patient management.
